notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
1.5 Patch Notes:

*Fixed several minor bugs.
*Fixed bug where timer speeds up after exiting quiz mid-game.
* Added more than 300 questions to increase replayability. 

A big thank you to everyone who has played our Back 2 School. 

Best, 
Trevor Burrows
Goldenrod Games
